boundary.source: OpenCity / Oorvani Foundation, BMC administrative wards

population.source: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, Civic Diary 2025, wardwise mid-year population estimate for 2023
population.licence: Publicly published municipal statistics; reuse terms not explicitly stated
population.limitations: Population is a municipal estimate, not measured e-waste generation and not a population-to-demand conversion. The 24 published ward values sum to 13,014,389, one person below the published city aggregate of 13,014,390; the app displays the sum of ward values.
